messages:
Priya: Heads-up — Newbridge flagged a regression after we merged their LoRA. Amounts sometimes render as words and sometimes as numbers depending on locale and prompt phrasing. Not consistent.
Michael: Can you paste a couple of concrete examples?
Priya: Sure — taken from their quick-eval pack:
User: "Total due: $3,450"
Model (en_US): "Total due: $3,450" (ok)
Model (es_ES): "Total a pagar: tres mil cuatrocientos cincuenta dólares" (bad)
Model (fr_FR): "Total 0 payer : 3 450,00 $" (ok)
Michael: Huh, Spanish gets verbalized while French keeps numerals. That points to training data skew in the adapter.
Diego: I checked the adapter training manifest — there are ~600 Spanish customer messages from forums where amounts are spelled out in prose. Adapter likely learned to prefer word tokens in spanish contexts. No locale tags used during finetune.
Anya: Also note: we merged onto base-xl-4bit para-quant. Quantization might be nudging topk distributions. Have we reproduced on int8/dense?
Priya: Good call. Quick repro matrix I ran:
- base-xl (dense) + adapter -> numeric-preserve 0.96
- base-xl-4bit + adapter -> numeric-preserve 0.58
- base-xl-int8 + adapter -> numeric-preserve 0.62
So quantized variants amplify the effect, but adapter is main contributor.
Michael: Can we diff logits/token probs across base vs base+adapter for the currency span?
Diego: Pasted short sniff:
```
--- base-xl
span tokens: ["3","45","0"] probs: [0.93, 0.9, 0.88]
--- base-xl+newbridge-lora-v1
span top tokens: ["tres","mil","cuatrocientos","cincuenta"] probs: [0.52,0.47,0.4,0.35]
```
eval-bot: quick-eval (newbridge-quickpack) finished: 300 examples. numeric_preserve: base 0.97, base+adapter 0.59, BLEU delta -0.04, safety hits +3
Anya: Short-term mitigation: we can do a tiny adapter patch focusing on Spanish invoices, with a token-preserve loss and locale-aware prefix signals. Also add a small KL regularizer to keep base distribution when currency symbols are present.
Lina: For safety, add currency unit tests to the quickpack and regression suite. Also run adversarial prompts like "Amount: 3.450" and language-mixing examples.
Michael: Plan:
1) Diego crafts a ~250-example Spanish invoice numerals patch set (maintain examples with currency symbols)
2) Train a 1k-step adapter delta (low lr) on a single A10; add KL-preserve term per Anya
3) Run eval-bot across en/es/fr/regression suite and token-prob diffs
4) If good, cut new adapter v1.1 (canary to Newbridge)
Priya: I'll notify Newbridge CSM and suggest temporary fallback to base-xl until canary completes. @newbridge-csm please standby.
Diego: Assembling patch now. ETA 45m. Will upload checkpoint when done.
Anya: I'll author the loss code and clamp sampling temp in eval harness to reduce quantization flakiness.
infra-bot: Job scheduled: small-adapter-patch on A10, max 2h. Job id: a10-882201
Diego: checkpoint uploaded: s3://redwood-dev/newbridge/patch-spanish-numerals-v1.ckpt
Priya: Kicking off eval-run. eval-bot will post results. Adding Lina's unit tests to quickpack now. :thumbsup:
